intro: Somewhere between two stations that no longer exist, the night train stopped. When it started again, every ticket had been replaced with a puzzle. At the head of the car, where the corridor narrows past the linen cupboard, there is a rack of eight hooks, and for eight passengers there were eight coats hung on the first night, but each morning the porter found a ninth hook had appeared among them, bare, as though something had been taken off and forgotten, and he took to chalking a tally beside the door each day, though no passenger would say whose coat it was that had never belonged to them. The drawings on the tickets, they noticed, each bore one more line than the thing it showed.
echo: Something has come off the rails, and not only the train.

puzzles.title: Last Call
puzzles.flavor: Not a single letter on the page, and yet it says something.

hints: Which short words are most common in English? Could any of them be hiding here?
Each symbol always stands for the same letter. The finished sentence tells you what to submit.
